action: Draft and send a formal letter of interest to RoboRide's regional fleet operations manager identifying Howard's Parts as a potential parts supplier for their Millfield vehicle maintenance. Include a preliminary capability list covering brake hardware, sensors, lubricants, and safety consumables that fleet maintenance requires. Also reach out to the local municipality's vehicle maintenance department — garbage trucks, transit buses, city fleet — with the same pitch. This is a cold outreach to B2B customers that don't know me yet.
